preserved_public_surface: authenticated shutdown evidence, 500 ms ACK bound, and 10 s absolute deadline
architecture: Keep the authenticated JSONL handshake synchronous, then split the socket into one persistent reader task and one persistent writer task.
Route critical events through a lossless backpressured FIFO of 16, interactions through a must-deliver FIFO of 16, and player state through one atomic latest-state watch slot.
Represent reset, generation, and optional latest state in one slot so reset followed immediately by new state cannot be missed; discard stale-generation interactions.
Use a capacity-one critical write lane with write-completion acknowledgement and a generation-tagged lifecycle lane of 32. Full lifecycle output is terminal.
Bias writer scheduling stop, critical, permit/generation change, then lifecycle. A lifecycle record uses writable plus one try_write; partial write is terminal JSONL corruption.
Factor raw child/control observation from settlement so the activated lifecycle can stop and join realtime before child cleanup while the public next_event preserves existing behavior.
Explicit teardown joins both pump tasks inside the existing absolute shutdown budget; Drop only signals and aborts as a final safety net.
invariants: Critical send succeeds only after the complete line is written within one absolute PROCESS_IO_TIMEOUT.
Checkpoint and authenticated shutdown consume only critical events; presence cannot enter their correlation streams.
A reset advances generation and atomically clears state and output permission.
A parsed correlated ACK queued before EOF remains observable.
Critical output can overtake every lifecycle record that has not begun writing.
Child exit cannot be starved by sustained control or presence traffic.
required_tests: player-state coalescing without blocking critical FIFO
interaction FIFO overflow on the seventeenth item
atomic reset generation and stale interaction discard
reset followed by new state before consumer wakeup
critical write completion and lifecycle priority
